phase_name: Interactive Workflow Evidence Coordination, Clarification, and Audit Infrastructure Implementation
summary: Implemented the Evidence Coordination, Clarification, and Audit infrastructure defined by IWC-001 v1.1 on top of Phase 143K's Session Infrastructure and Phase 143L's Transition Engine. Read IWC-001 v1.1 (full text, in particular §8 Evidence, §9 Clarification, §13 Audit, and the full §21 requirement enumeration), CHGR-001, Phase 143J's implementation plan (§16 Evidence Coordinator / Clarification Controller / Audit Recorder responsibility rows), Phase 143K's and 143L's reports and full package source, Phase 143I.2, TAMC-001, TAMPC-001, and PROJECT_STATUS.md directly before writing any code. Implemented three new sibling packages: pcae.interactive_workflow.evidence (EvidenceItem -- immutable, no authority/approval/confirmation/CHGR field; EvidenceCoordinator -- registration with duplicate rejection, content-deterministic ordering by (collected_at, evidence_id) independent of registration order, missing-evidence gap reporting; no evaluate/score/recommend/decide_readiness/transition method exists), pcae.interactive_workflow.clarification (Clarification -- immutable, copy-on-write with_response/with_tag; ClarificationState; validate_classification_tag synchronously rejects recommendation/persuasion/approval/authorization/decision classification at both construction and with_tag, enforcing IWC-001 §9.1's four-act boundary structurally; ClarificationController -- request/response registration, duplicate and double-response rejection, immutable request-ordered history; no recommend/persuade/prioritize/decide/transition method exists), and pcae.interactive_workflow.audit (AuditEvent -- immutable, frozen payload, no authority metadata beyond session_id; AuditRecorder -- append-only with duplicate rejection, append-order deterministic retrieval optionally filtered by event_type, immutable snapshot history; no mutate/delete/publish/notify/create_report/create_chgr method exists). All three coordinators are scoped to one session identifier via the existing session.identity.validate_session_id syntax check (passive structural integration) and import neither SessionCoordinator nor TransitionEngine (confirmed by a dedicated AST-based test). Added three sibling serialization modules (evidence_schema.py, clarification_schema.py, audit_schema.py) mirroring 143K's schema.py discipline; audit_schema.py raises the new AuditSerializationFailureError specifically. Extended errors.py with six new InteractiveWorkflowError subclasses (DuplicateEvidenceError, UnknownEvidenceError, DuplicateClarificationError, InvalidClarificationError, DuplicateAuditEventError, AuditSerializationFailureError). Session Coordinator (143K) and every state_machine/* module (143L) were not modified and do not yet call any of this phase's three new coordinators -- wiring deferred to 143N onward. No decision selection, Preview Digest generation, confirmation, publication, or CHGR creation implemented. See docs/PHASE_143M_INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_EVIDENCE_COORDINATION_CLARIFICATION_AND_AUDIT_INFRASTRUCTURE_IMPLEMENTATION.md.
tests_added_or_updated: tests/test_iwc_143m_evidence_clarification_audit.py added: 61 new tests covering Evidence (model field/type validation, frozen-metadata immutability, forbidden-field-absence, registration, duplicate rejection, unknown-identifier lookup failure, content-deterministic ordering across opposite registration orders, timestamp-tie identifier tiebreak, missing-evidence reporting with and without gaps, session-identifier-scoping validation, no-evaluation/scoring-method negative test, serialization round-trip plus unsupported-version and malformed-payload rejection), Clarification (model field validation, initial-state correctness, copy-on-write response production, double-response rejection, parametrized forbidden-classification-tag rejection across six labels and casings, parametrized permitted-tag acceptance, controller request/response lifecycle, duplicate-request rejection, response-to-unknown-request rejection, controller-layer double-response rejection, request-order history preservation, history-snapshot immutability across later registrations, controller-tag boundary rejection, no-recommend/persuade/prioritize/decide/transition-method negative test, session-identifier-scoping validation, serialization round-trip plus unsupported-version rejection), Audit (model field validation, frozen-payload immutability, no-authority-metadata-beyond-session-identity field-set check, append/retrieve, duplicate-event-id rejection, append-order history preservation, event-type filtering, history-snapshot immutability across later appends, no-mutate/delete/publish/notify/create-report/create-chgr-method negative test, session-identifier-scoping validation, unknown-event get returning None, serialization round-trip plus unsupported-version and audit-specific malformed-payload rejection), Integration boundary (shared session-identifier scoping across all three coordinators; AST-based static-analysis test confirming none of evidence.coordinator/clarification.controller/audit.recorder imports SessionCoordinator or TransitionEngine by name), and Regression (SessionState's ten members and SCHEMA_VERSION unchanged; TransitionEngine.apply still transitions Created -> EvidenceReady correctly; pcae runtime inspect --json still reports the observe capability). All 61 pass; 571 pass combined with 143K's 110 and 143L's 400.

No decision selection, Preview Digest generation, confirmation, publication, or CHGR creation exist anywhere in this phase's code.
